card.name: Last digit of dose numbers
card.fires_on: The final digit of a multi-digit number just before a unit such as mg, mcg, mL or m 2 in dosing text. It also fires on the closing part of unit expressions like m/s^2.

modes.label: Last digit before a unit
modes.description: A trailing digit of a dose number, right before mg, mcg, mL or similar.
